name: Atal Incubation Centres (AIC) Grant
summary: Supports the establishment of world-class incubation facilities to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
benefit_description: Grant-in-aid of up to Rs. 10 crores for a maximum period of 5 years to cover capital and operational expenditures.

criteria.description: Applicant must provide at least 10,000 sq. ft. of ready-to-use built-up space for the incubation centre.
criteria.source_quote: The applicant institution would have to provide at least 10,000 sq. ft. of ready-to-use, built-up space, for the exclusive use of the proposed AIC.

criteria.description: Non-government applicants must not be loss-making in any of the previous three years.
criteria.source_quote: Non-government applicants that are loss-making in any of the previous three years will not be considered.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Obtain past 3 years of audited financials to prove profitability
Provide proof of being a registered trust, society, or section 8 company
Develop a comprehensive 5-year operational plan detailing business planning support and mentor accessibility

windows.notes: Calls for applications are announced periodically on the AIM portal.

benefits.description: Grants-in-aid to cover capital and operational expenditures over 5 years.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Funds disbursed in tranches over 5 years; separate third-party auditable bank accounts are required.
benefits.source_quote: AIM will provide a grant-in-aid of up to Rs. 10 crores for a maximum period of 5 years to cover the capital and operational expenditures to establish the proposed AIC.
